Backup secondary tertiary heat sources play role modelling. Agents choose replacing current fuel source tech adopting heat pump. Risk aversion “status quo bias” lowers rate adoption heat pumps even cases offers better financial return. Possibilities oil $`\rightarrow`$ gas excluded option households near gas network. less common, significant, event point view energy efficiency decision household carry home energy efficiency retrofit. rate households take option set parameter p. fit calibration historical data. household investment decision involves choice $`BER`$ upgrade $`BER_{old} \rightarrow BER_{new}`$, well potential technology shift $`tech_{old} \rightarrow tech_{new}`$. household may also choose retain current heating system. choice may advantageous expected residual value existing asset high. function optimise_upgrade() determines optimum upgrade choice, including effect currently applicable grants.
